_meta.unit: All need bars are 0-100. Money is G. Yields are 'units/day' unless a cycleDays is given. Time is expressed as day-fractions t in [0,1) where t=0 is dawn/morning.
_meta.sourceOfTruth: docs/design/game-design.md sections 5,6,7,16. Base prices, rank net-worth thresholds and the 12-day/48-day calendar are copied verbatim from that doc; all sibling agents must align to it.
_meta.calendarNote: daysPerSeason is 12 (NOT the task's generic ~14 default) to match the canonical calendar in game-design.md 5.8/16.6 so seasonal events authored in content.json line up.
_meta.pairsWith: data/content.json (owns the upgrades[]/achievements[]/events[]/shop arrays; this file specs their mini-languages and all tuning constants)

start._worldNote: ranchSize is the single rundown starter plot the player begins on; worldSize is the full vast grid revealed plot-by-plot (see landPlots). Vastness pillar: the map is ~36x the starter plot.
start._startingBuildingsNote: Positions are suggested defaults inside the 16x12 starter plot; world/world-gen agent may relocate. No well/silo/dairy at start (those are Stage 2/3 unlocks). market_stall is deliberately the 'rickety' free starter stall.

dailyTick._note: Canonical order of operations each in-game morning. animals.js/economy.js/crops.js must follow this so results are deterministic and agents agree.
order: 1. advance clock: day++, roll season/year on boundary (12/48).
2. market: step every price index (clamped random walk), decay supplyGlut, recompute today's prices.
3. weather: roll today's weather from weather.oddsBySeason.
4. crops: apply water (rain or sprinkler or manual-yesterday), advance growth, run wither/overripe checks.
5. animals: decay hunger & cleanliness; feed_trough auto-feeds from silo; recompute happinessTarget and ease happiness; update health; decay pet stacks; age babies toward adult.
6. production: for each adult, compute yield, roll quality tier, deposit to storage (clamped by warehouse capacity; overflow is auto-sold at 70% with a gentle toast).
7. processing: advance dairy timers; emit finished products into storage.
8. passive: accumulate manure; apply companion/decor auras; apply dog/cat market aura for the day.
9. events & goals: evaluate event triggers (chancePerDay/cooldown), fire effects; tally lifetime stats; check achievements; check goal board & rank-up.

formulas.happinessTarget: clamp(happinessBase + happinessFromFed*(hunger/100) + happinessFromClean*(cleanliness/100) + petBonus + min(companionBonus, companionAuraCap) + shelterBonus + (sheltered ? 0 : happinessWeatherPenaltyUnsheltered[weather]), 0, 100)
formulas.petBonus: petStacks * happinessFromPet, where petStacks decays by (petDecayPerDay/ (happinessFromPet)) worth per day; simplest impl: petBonus = clamp(petBonus - petDecayPerDay, 0, happinessFromPet*petMaxStacks)
formulas.neglectIsSoft: No need ever causes death or debt; low needs only reduce production and quality (see production). Recovery to full is always possible with care.

speciesTraits._note: heat/cold resist 0..1 feed seasonMult for every animal's production (cows override with per-breed values in production.byBreed). Higher resist = smaller seasonal yield loss.

milkYield.formula: milkYield = baseMilkPerDay[breed] * happinessMult * healthMult * seasonMult * feedMult * upgradeMult * ageMult
milkYield.seasonMult: spring => 1.05 ; autumn => 1.00 ; summer => 1 - heatStress*(1 - heatResist[breed]) ; winter => 1 - coldStress*(1 - coldResist[breed])
milkYield.feedMult: premium feed (alfalfa) => 1.15 ; good feed (corn/wheat) => 1.05 ; basic feed (grass/hay/clover) => 0.95 ; starving (hunger<thresholds.starving) => 0.70
milkYield.ageMult: baby => 0.0 ; juvenile => 0.0 ; adult => 1.0 (production begins the day an animal reaches adult; see breeding.babyGrowthDays)
milkYield.upgradeMult: product of all bought upgrade effects whose target is milkYield or allYield (default 1.0)
milkYield._uncollectedNote: Milk keeps accumulating up to 2 days of yield if the player does not collect; beyond that it soft-caps (no waste toast is scary, just 'ミルクがいっぱい！').

quality.feedQualityRef: feedQuality is the 0..1 value of what the animal last ate (see feed.feedItems); unfed defaults to 0.3
quality.premiumOutcome: each production day, if rng() < premiumChance the whole day's milk is produced as quality_milk instead of milk; otherwise milk.

tiers.fine: 70 <= qualityScore < 85 (raw milk sells at +8% if not upgraded to quality_milk)
tiers.premium: qualityScore >= 85 or a successful premium roll -> yields quality_milk

quality._wagyuNote: wagyu milk is always emitted as quality_milk regardless of roll (prestige breed); still scaled by all yield multipliers.

otherAnimals._note: egg/wool/goat_milk/etc. reuse the SAME happinessMult, healthMult and seasonMult (using that species' speciesTraits resist) as milk. Only the base rate and product id change.

processing._note: Recipe definitions live here for balance; content.json may reference by id. Times are in in-game hours (a day = 24h; realSecondsPerGameDay=120 so 8h ~ 40s at 1x).

dairy.marginNote: 3 milk (75G) -> 1 cheese (120G): +60% before fees, but gated by slots/time so raw-vs-process is a real choice.

feed.feedCostNote: Buying feed is the main recurring expense; growing your own (grass->hay->corn->alfalfa) is the mid-game efficiency unlock that closes the loop. Upgrade target feedCost multiplies buyCost.

market._basePricesNote: milk..manure copied verbatim from game-design.md 16.5. Crop/feed prices added here for the harvest economy.

weatherDemand._note: Small same-day nudges; keep subtle so weather is flavor, not a rug-pull.

supplyGlut.note: Selling a huge batch of one good in a day temporarily depresses only that good's price; recovers over days. Teaches diversification without ever making a good worthless.

trendModel.description: Per-good priceIndex is a clamped, mean-reverting random walk. All randomness is described as multiplier RANGES; the programmer draws them with Game.util.rng, not any specific API.
trendModel.stepFormula: indexNext = clamp( index + uniform(-baseVolatility, +baseVolatility) + uniform(-moodJitter, +moodJitter) + (1.0 - index)*meanReversion , priceBand[0], priceBand[1] )
trendModel.finalSellPriceFormula: sellPrice = round( basePrice[good] * index[good] * seasonalDemand[category][season] * weatherDemand[category][weather] * (1 - supplyGlutPenalty[good]) * (1 - sellFeePct + marketStallBonus) )
trendModel.finalBuyPriceFormula: buyPrice = round( basePrice[good] * index[good] * seasonalDemand[category][season] * (1 + buyMarkupPct) )
trendModel.marketStallBonus: 0 if no market_stall, else marketStallTierBonusPct[stallTier]; also waives the sell fee visually by netting into one number
trendModel.clampNote: index stays in [0.60,1.60] so a good never crashes to zero nor moons; typical daily swing is ~+-30%.

netWorth._note: Rank thresholds are checked against netWorth so players cannot cheese ranks by hoarding cash, nor by owning stuff while broke.
netWorth.formula: netWorth = cash + sum(animal.marketValue * animalValuePct) + sum(building.cost * buildingValuePct) + sum(product.qty * basePrice[product]) + sum(landPlotPaid * landValuePct)

offspringInheritRules.breed: same species; if both parents same breed -> that breed. If different breeds -> 50/50 pick one parent's breed (no unhappy cross outcomes; cosmetic mixes only).
offspringInheritRules.temperamentBiasNote: The +12/-8 asymmetry gives a gentle upward drift so breeding your best animals slowly improves the herd (genetics-lite).

crops.baseGrowFormula: progress += (1 / (growDays * cropGrowMult)) * waterEffect * seasonEffect * fertilizerEffect * weatherEffect ; harvest-ready when progress >= 1.0
crops.cropGrowMultNote: cropGrowMult is a TIME multiplier lowered by upgrades (cropGrow*0.8 => 20% faster). Default 1.0.
crops.seasonEffectNote: deadSeason (0.0) means a non-hardy crop makes no progress and begins to wither (see witherRules); hardy crops treat winter as offSeason instead of deadSeason.

witherRules.note: Withering is never punishing beyond losing that tile's crop; it drops a little manure as consolation and the tile is instantly replantable.

auras._note: Realizes the 看板犬/看板猫 market aura, mini_cow/rabbit happiness aura, pond/sunflower charm, and horse mobility flavor.

capacities._note: capacity+N upgrade target adds to the relevant building's cap. Animal houses cap head-count; storage caps stacks.
capacities.pasture: usable crop tiles = building footprint area

costs._rankNote: Copied verbatim from game-design.md 7.1/16.7. A rank-up ALSO requires clearing that rank's goal set (defined in content.json); net worth alone is necessary but not sufficient.
costs.expectedCashNote: Approx liquid cash a healthy player holds when they cross into each rank (the rest of net worth is animals/buildings/land). Used to sanity-check that the next rank's key purchases are affordable soon after arriving.

affordCheckpoints.label: ★1 序盤 — Day ~3, 所持 ~800G
affordCheckpoints.teaches: spend -> daily income: 3 hens = ~45G/day eggs, paying back the coop in ~15 days while milk funds seeds.

affordCheckpoints.label: ★3 なかば — 所持 ~8,000G
affordCheckpoints.teaches: unlocks the milk->cheese pipeline (+60% margins), a premium-milk breed, water, and first automation, with a healthy buffer for feed/seeds.

affordCheckpoints.label: ★5 大台 — 所持 ~200,000G
affordCheckpoints.teaches: full automation + luxury tier (wagyu/alpaca) is comfortably affordable, leaving ~145k for region-2 land plots and more premium herd.

costs.curveSanityNote: Income per healthy day roughly scales: S1 ~120-300G, S2 ~500-1500G, S3 ~3k-10k, S4 ~25k-90k, S5 ~150k+. Each rank's headline unlocks cost ~10-30% of the cash you hold on arrival, so progress always feels within reach, never grindy or walled.

landPlots.costFormula: plotCost(n) = round( base * growth^(n-2) )  where n is the plot index being purchased; plot 1 is the free starter, so the first purchasable plot (n=2) costs exactly base.
landPlots._forgivenessNote: Buildings/animals sell back or relocate for near-full value (90%) within a grace window so experimentation is never punished (soft-failure pillar).

upgradesEffectSpec._purpose: Defines the mini-language the programmer must interpret for content.upgrades[].effect (and reused by achievement/event rewards). content.json owns the upgrade cards; this owns their meaning.
upgradesEffectSpec.format: content.upgrades[].effect is an ARRAY of token strings. Each token is either 'TARGET OP VALUE' (no spaces) or a bare FLAG token. Multiple upgrades stack; same-target multipliers multiply together, additive tokens sum.

operators.*: multiply the target's running modifier by VALUE (e.g. milkYield*1.15)
operators.+: add VALUE to the target (fractions for percent-style targets; integers for counts). e.g. priceBonus+0.1, capacity+5
operators.-: subtract VALUE from the target. e.g. needsDecay-0.1
operators.=: set/override the target to VALUE (rare; use for hard caps)

priceBonus.modifies: added to sell multiplier (like an extra market_stall bonus)

capacity.modifies: the target building's capacity (context: which building the upgrade card names)

needsDecay.modifies: global multiplier on hunger & cleanliness decay

flags.autoMilk: cows auto-collect milk each morning (no manual tap needed)
flags.autoFeed: enables trough auto-feed globally even without a trough nearby (ranch-wide feeder research)
flags.autoWater: all crops auto-watered each morning (ranch-wide, like blanket sprinklers)
flags.bulkSell: unlock one-tap sell-all in the market panel
flags.nightWork: production/processing continues through the night phase at normal rate
flags.rainShelter: animals count as sheltered from rain/snow happiness penalties ranch-wide

achievementsSpec._purpose: Defines the condition mini-language for content.achievements[].condition and the reward tokens (which reuse eventsSpec.effectTokens).
achievementsSpec.conditionFormat: A string of one or more clauses joined by '&&' (all must hold) or '||' (any). Each clause is 'TOKEN OP VALUE'. No mixed &&/|| precedence — evaluate left to right, or keep clauses single-operator for safety.

tokens.day: absolute day count since game start (1-based, never resets)
tokens.season: current season id; compare with == e.g. season==autumn
tokens.breeds: count of distinct cow breeds owned
tokens.maxHappyAnimals: count of animals at happiness >= thresholds.blissful
tokens.buildings.<id>: count of a building, e.g. buildings.dairy>=1, buildings.sprinkler>=6

achievementsSpec.rewardFormat: content.achievements[].reward is an ARRAY of effect tokens (same set as eventsSpec.effectTokens). Rewards are always positive.

eventsSpec._purpose: Defines triggers and effect tokens for content.events[]. Effects are the shared reward mini-language used by upgrades' non-numeric grants and by achievement rewards.
eventsSpec.triggerFormat: content.events[].trigger uses the SAME condition mini-language as achievementsSpec (TOKEN OP VALUE joined by &&/||). It gates eligibility; scheduling fields then decide if/when it actually fires.

schedulingFields.season: restrict to a season id (or omit for any)
schedulingFields.weatherAny: array of weather ids that allow the event (e.g. ['rainy'])
schedulingFields.dateExact: fixed calendar slot, e.g. { season: 'autumn', day: 8 } for a festival
schedulingFields.weightBase: relative selection weight when several events are eligible the same day
schedulingFields.cooldownDays: minimum days between two firings of this event
schedulingFields.onceOnly: true = can fire at most once per save
schedulingFields.onRankUp: true = evaluate on rank-up instead of daily

eventsSpec.effectFormat: content.events[].effect (and each choices[].effect) is an ARRAY of effect tokens. All outcomes are positive or neutral (soft-failure: no event ever removes animals, bankrupts, or hard-locks).

effectTokens.money-N: charge N gold (only as an opt-in choice cost; never forced below 0 -> clamped, triggers stipend if needed)
effectTokens.priceAll*F: scale ALL sell prices by F; pair with 'days:D' or defaults to 1 day
effectTokens.price:<good>*F: scale one good's price (e.g. price:cheese*1.3) for 'days:D'
effectTokens.days:D: modifier that sets the duration (days) of the preceding temporary buff token
effectTokens.spawnAnimal:<species|breed>: gift one free animal (e.g. spawnAnimal:rabbit, spawnAnimal:jersey) — the stray-kitten/traveling-merchant delight
effectTokens.happinessAll+N: add N happiness to every animal
effectTokens.happiness:<species>+N: add N happiness to one species
effectTokens.healthAll+N: add N health to every animal
effectTokens.give:<item>+N: grant N of a product/feed/decor item (e.g. give:cheese+5)
effectTokens.unlock:<type>:<id>: unlock content early (e.g. unlock:building:dairy, unlock:animal:alpaca, unlock:recipe:goat_cheese)
effectTokens.research+N: grant N research points (for the upgrades/research board)
effectTokens.weather:<w>: set tomorrow's weather (festival flavor, e.g. weather:sunny)
effectTokens.spawnDecor:<id>: place/gift a decor object (e.g. spawnDecor:rainbow, spawnDecor:snowman)
effectTokens.buff:<target>*F:days: temporary named buff, e.g. buff:cropGrow*0.8:3 (3 days of faster crops)

eventsSpec.choiceFormat: An event may present choices: [{ label, cost? (G or item), effect: [tokens] }]. Declining is always a free, guilt-free option ('またこんど♪').

choices.label: レア羊を むかえる

difficultyCurve.philosophy: Rewarding, gentle, and dead-end-proof. Every in-game day of basic care is net-positive; neglect only softens output; nothing is ever permanently lost. The player is always safe to relax and safe to experiment.

softFailure.stipendMessage: シズクの応援ボーナス♪ すこしだけ おすそわけ〜！

mentorLoan.note: A gentle interest-free advance from Shizuku's mentor; auto-repays a small slice of sales. Never spirals, never seizes anything, can be ignored.

antiStall.floorNote: Turnips and eggs are always sold above their input cost so a stuck player can always dig out with cheap, fast income.
antiStall.belowCurveNote: If net worth trails the stageMoneyArc for the current rank, goal rewards and market prices nudge up ~10% (invisible rubber-banding) to keep momentum.

pacingTargets.note: Ranges assume casual daily check-ins. Faster play compresses these; there is no timer pressure either way.

guarantees: No hard game-over and no single win screen; ★7 is 'arrival, not ending'.
Expired contracts/events are shrugged off, never penalized.
Sad/dirty/hungry animals fully recover with care and clearly signal their need.
Every good is always sellable at a floor price; no good ever crashes to zero (priceBand min 0.60).
Buildings/animals refund ~90% within a grace window so mistakes never sting.

_formulasQuickRef.milkYield: baseMilkPerDay[breed] * happinessMult * healthMult * seasonMult * feedMult * upgradeMult * ageMult
_formulasQuickRef.plotCost: round(1500 * 1.9^(n-2))  (n>=2; plot 1 is the free starter)
